nodes.label: Omniverse API Keys & Sync Configuration Guide
nodes.rationale: Omniverse is a 100% decentralized, client-side, server-less app. It connects directly to public APIs from your device to keep your data, API limits, and credentials entirely in your hands, offering absolute privacy.
nodes.norm_label: omniverse api keys & sync configuration guide

nodes.label: Zero-Config QR Sync
nodes.rationale: Transfer API keys, settings, watch history, and account links securely and instantly between devices without touching any third-party server.

nodes.label: The Movie Database (TMDB) Read Access Token
nodes.rationale: TMDB API read access token is required to load movie/TV metadata (posters, backdrops, trailers, cast details, trending feeds, and search results) directly from the client device.
nodes.norm_label: the movie database (tmdb) read access token

nodes.label: Trakt.tv Developer Client Keys
nodes.rationale: Trakt developer credentials handle scrobbling (tracking watch progress in real-time), syncing watchlists, and maintaining a secure, encrypted backup of the entire Omniverse configuration in a private list on the user's profile.

nodes.label: AniList Sync Token
nodes.rationale: AniList handles searching for anime metadata, anime recommendations, and synchronizing playback progress.

nodes.label: Pixeldrain API Key
nodes.rationale: Pixeldrain key is optional but highly recommended to raise streaming and download rate limits and unlock premium high-speed streaming.

nodes.label: TVDB API Key & Subscriber PIN
nodes.rationale: TheTVDB is utilized for advanced live TV listings, channel schedules, and extra TV series metadata.

nodes.label: Omniverse Native Rewrite Build Plan
nodes.rationale: Reimplement the Flutter omniplay app (20,366 LOC) with two fully native apps (SwiftUI for iOS and Kotlin + Jetpack Compose for Android) to achieve feature parity, absolute performance (120Hz/ProMotion), and deep system integration.

nodes.label: iOS Native App Subsystem
nodes.rationale: Built using SwiftUI, featuring vivid glassmorphism and an Apple-TV-inspired interface. Configured via XcodeGen (`project.yml`) and targeted for Apple devices with max refresh rates (ProMotion).

nodes.label: Android Native App Subsystem
nodes.rationale: Built using Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Compose-for-TV. Serves phones, tablets, and Android TV with a universal signed APK. Optimized for high refresh rates using WindowManager preferred display mode.

nodes.label: VidSrc Extractor Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Resolves video playbacks using an extractor chain: embed -> /rcp/{hash} -> /prorcp/ -> m3u8 stream. Employs WebView-based Cloudflare Turnstile resolution to bypass scraping protections.

nodes.label: AllAnime AES-256-CTR Decoder
nodes.rationale: AllAnime (ani-cli) uses custom AES-256-CTR decoding with a stable key derived from SHA256 of 'Xot36i3lK3:v1' and a 90-entry hex map to extract direct media streams securely.

nodes.label: Live TV Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Aggregates iptv-org JSON + M3U, scrapes yarrlist, integrates tv247.biz, and runs background HEAD-probe scanning for active, healthy stream links.

nodes.label: Native Media Player Subsystem
nodes.rationale: Utilizes AVPlayer (iOS) and ExoPlayer (Android). Features Trakt scrobble thresholds (start on play, pause on pause, stop at complete), AniSkip auto-skip, advanced subtitle rendering (.ass/.vtt), and 12s stall recovery.

nodes.label: Omniverse Media Companion
nodes.rationale: An elegant, ultra-premium media companion app. Built using 100% pure native code, glides at a silky-smooth 120Hz, offers completely serverless operation with absolute privacy, zero tracking, and open-source licensing.

nodes.label: Netflix-Style Next Episode Countdown
nodes.rationale: Displays a premium sliding card with a circular countdown ring when less than 10 seconds remain, enabling seamless auto-play or manual TV D-pad trigger for the next episode.

nodes.label: Continue Watching Shelf
nodes.rationale: Eliminates visual clutter by grouping progress by show (one unified card per series) instead of listing separate entries for each episode.

nodes.label: Electron Desktop Application
nodes.rationale: A premium, ultra-fast Electron-based desktop app that complements the mobile experience by supporting ad-blocked VidSrc streaming, zero-config sync, and high-performance Live TV playback on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

nodes.label: Continuous In-App Update Engine
nodes.rationale: Provides dynamic OTA updates without losing watch history or settings, powered by an in-app markdown parser that displays release notes directly on-screen.

nodes.label: Omniverse Cross-Device Sync Protocol
nodes.rationale: Specifies a peer-to-peer-like QR transfer mechanism that packages all API keys, settings, and Trakt auth tokens in a single standard base64-encoded JSON string (`OMNIVERSE-SYNC1:<base64>`) to bypass any central servers or external cloud storage dependencies.

nodes.label: QR Payload JSON Schema
nodes.rationale: Stable, compact JSON schema containing Trakt, TMDB, TVDB, Pixeldrain, and AniList credentials/tokens along with user settings. Omits watch history to stay under QR size constraints (fits within error correction level M).

nodes.label: QR Decode & Restore Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Verifies and strips the `OMNIVERSE-SYNC1:` prefix, decodes the base64 JSON payload, populates ApiCredentials and UserSettings, persists to secure storage (Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences), and refreshes AppState.

nodes.label: Cross-Platform Camera QR Scanner
nodes.rationale: Uses native camera pipelines (iOS: AVCaptureSession + AVCaptureMetadataOutput; Android: zxing-android-embedded ScanContract) to capture and decode QR codes instantly, falling back to secure manual paste.

nodes.label: Native Enterprise Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: Automates multi-platform compilation, testing, and distribution. Compiles signed release APKs for Android, generates iOS projects via XcodeGen and compiles unsigned IPAs, packages multi-OS Electron apps, and automatically publishes them to GitHub Releases on push to main/master.

nodes.label: Android CI Build Job
nodes.rationale: Builds the native Android app using Ubuntu runner, JDK 17, and Gradle. Runs debug unit tests and compiles the signed release APK, which is uploaded as a build artifact.

nodes.label: iOS CI Build Job
nodes.rationale: Builds the native iOS app using macOS-14 runner. Selects Xcode 16, installs XcodeGen, generates the Xcode project, runs Swift unit tests on iPad mini simulator, compiles the release app bundle, and packages it into an unsigned IPA artifact.

nodes.label: Desktop CI Build Job
nodes.rationale: Builds Electron desktop binaries in parallel across Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows runners using Node.js 24. Stamped with a release version, it packages .exe (Windows), .dmg (macOS), and .AppImage/.deb (Linux) installers.

nodes.label: Production Release Publisher Job
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates downloading all compilation artifacts (Android APK, iOS IPA, desktop DMG/EXE/AppImage/DEB) and publishing them under a unified GitHub Release tagged as `v2.1.<run_number>` with automated release notes.

nodes.label: CMakeLists.txt for Renderscript Clang Include
nodes.rationale: Configuration file for the RenderScript LLVM Clang compiler headers included in the Android SDK build tools version 35.0.0-2.

nodes.label: Android 35 SDK Platform Features
nodes.rationale: Defines hardware and software feature flags (e.g. audio latency, camera features, biometrics) supported natively by Android Platform API level 35.

nodes.label: Android 35 SDK Activity Actions
nodes.rationale: Lists standard Android Intent activity actions (like VIEW, SEND, MAIN) recognized by Platform level 35.

nodes.label: Android WebView No Domain Error Concept
nodes.rationale: Provides localized error messages and troubleshooting suggestions for users when a domain name lookup fails, resolving connectivity or DNS problems cleanly.
nodes.norm_label: android webview no domain error concept

nodes.label: Android WebView Load Error Concept
nodes.rationale: Generic localized fallback view containing placeholders (%s and %e) to output detailed network load errors in the system WebView.

nodes.label: Desktop Sync Pairing QR Code Component
nodes.norm_label: desktop sync pairing qr code component

nodes.label: Android WebKit Fallback Error Pages
nodes.rationale: These fallback HTML templates provide user-friendly, localized troubleshooting suggestions and error details when a WebView fails to resolve or load a web address, improving offline user experience.

nodes.label: Glassmorphic Visual Design Pattern
nodes.rationale: Using high transparency, blur, and fine borders (backdrop-blur-xl, GlassTabBar, GlassTopBar) creates a premium cinematic visual design that remains consistent across desktop and iOS platforms.
